svg.title: How an Auto Scaling Group works
svg.desc: Animated scene: rising traffic pushes CPU on two EC2 instances above 70 percent, a CloudWatch alarm rings, a third instance boots and shares the load, then traffic drops and the group scales back in. Desired capacity changes 2, 3, 2 within min 2 and max 4.
svg.text: How an Auto Scaling Group works

g.text: CloudWatch alarm fires: the group scales out to 3 instances
The new instance is ready and shares the load
Traffic drops: CPU falls and one instance drains (scale in)

svg.text: CPU rises, an alarm adds an instance, and the group scales back in when load drops.
